premises.text: Local governments struggle with data trapped in silos and legacy systems
premises.evidence_span: the data is trapped in silos. Cities have many different legacy systems.

premises.text: Medium-sized cities spend significant resources on manual data processing
premises.evidence_span: a medium-sized city spends more than 100,000 euros per year just on manual data processing.

premises.text: Politea can integrate data from existing legacy systems to provide actionable insights
premises.evidence_span: We take data from any existing legacy system and produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals.

premises.text: Politea's platform is modular and aligned with various city services
premises.evidence_span: The Politea platform is modular and aligned with the city services, ranging from childcare to fire departments to infrastructure.

premises.text: City leaders can use Politea to track performance and forecast demand
premises.evidence_span: city leaders can track their performance, optimize their costs, and forecast the demand over the next years.

premises.text: Politea can digitize data that exists only on paper
premises.evidence_span: if the data exists only on paper, no problem, we digitize it as a service.

premises.text: Politea's competition includes legacy systems and consultancies that do not meet local needs
premises.evidence_span: legacy systems can provide all automatic integrations. Consultancies deliver static and expensive reports.

premises.text: The GovTech market in Europe has high potential for growth
premises.evidence_span: The GovTech market in Europe is young and has high potential.

premises.text: Politea operates on a software-as-a-service business model with setup and annual fees
premises.evidence_span: We run a software-as-a-service business model with a one-time setup fee and an annual license fee.

premises.text: The team has a mix of experience in digital products and public sector policy
premises.evidence_span: Our team combines the best of two worlds. Our CPO has more than 15 years of experience in building digital products.

value.text: City leaders can make data-driven decisions to improve citizen services
value.evidence_span: all city leaders across Europe make data and pilot decisions improving the life of millions of their citizens.

notes: Customer count and lead generation are excluded as traction.
